source: The game's own RpgStateUtils.DefenseRatingToFactor, called in game (LootDump F11 damage probe) at DEF 0-50,000.

notes: The multiplier depends only on the defender's DEF: every hit is reduced by the same percentage, whatever its size (1000 DEF = x0.846 on a 1,000 or a 2,000 hit).
DEF can never reduce a hit by more than 85% (floor 0.15).
Boss DEF above 3,000 (e.g. Ulgorim stage 20, 11,000) uses the same curve.

unconfirmed: How ignore-DEF, element advantage, crit, damage-taken effects and tolerance combine with this multiplier: the in-game probe of the full damage function did not return usable values yet (issue #123).
The 0.15 floor and 5000 scale are fitted to the game's outputs (exact to 6 decimals at every sample), not read from config.
